title: Proclamers, The - I`m Gonna Be (500 Miles)

lines.l: 500 miles an hour, 500 more, just to be the man who walked a thousand miles, then fall down at your door.
When I'm working, yes I know I'm gonna be, I'm gonna be the man who's working hard for you.
And when the money comes in for the work I do, I'll pass almost every penny on to you.
When I come home, oh, I know I'm gonna be
I'm gonna be the man who comes back home to you
And if I throw, well, I know I'm gonna be
I'm gonna be the man who's going over you
But I would walk 500 miles and I would walk 500 more
Is to be a man
What's a thousand miles
To fall down at you tall
